mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM mcp_api_keys WHERE key_hash = #{keyHash} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM mcp_api_keys WHERE user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_api_keys (id, user_id, key_hash, key_prefix, name, expires_at, created_at) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{keyHash}, #{keyPrefix}, #{name}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
